nuggets.text: Head coach Aaron Glenn was a Jets draft pick himself, taken 12th overall as a cornerback in 1994.
The Jets were born as the Titans of New York, so this game pits the original Titans against today's Titans.
The Jets name was chosen from 500 suggestions sent in by friends, enemies and advertising agencies.
Geno Smith is back where it all began: the Jets drafted him in 2013 and traded for him again this offseason.
Jets offensive coordinator Frank Reich once led the Bills back from 35-3 down to win a playoff game in overtime.
Frank Reich was the expansion Carolina Panthers' first starting quarterback and threw their first-ever touchdown pass.
Jets rookie David Bailey tied for the most sacks in major college football last season, with 14.5 at Texas Tech.
Rookie tight end Kenyon Sadiq was clocked at 4.39 seconds in the 40-yard dash and posted a 43.5-inch vertical jump.
Bloomington, Indiana, once temporarily renamed a park pond "D'Angelo's Pond" to honor Jets rookie D'Angelo Ponds.
Jets rookie Omar Cooper Jr. was the leading receiver on Indiana's first-ever national championship team.
